title: Look very nice and are good quality
text: Look very nice and are good quality. These Serving utensils not only look great, but they work just as well.  Everyone thought they were real stainless steel serving utensils until they lifted them.  Enjoy your party with elegant looking disposable (or wash and use again) utensils.  Toss or wash, it's up to you!

product_metadata.title: Mozaik Premium Plastic Classic Stainless Steel Serving Utensil Set, 6 pieces
features: Set includes three (3) serving spoons and three (3) serving forks
Simple and classic premium plastic servers have a patented stainless steel coating with a silverware-like finish
Suitable for indoor or outdoor entertaining
Can withstand temperatures up to 180 degrees
Reusable and/or recyclable. Do not use in microwave/dishwasher; Hand wash for re-use
description: Entertaining friends and family is a lot of fun, but when the last guest walks out the door, there’s usually an overwhelming pile of dirty dishes and wine glasses. But paper plates aren’t always sturdy, plastic cutlery can be flimsy, and while you wouldn’t want your guests sipping a delicious vintage from a red plastic cup, you also don’t want your favorite wine glasses getting broken during a particularly rowdy game of charades.

Mozaik Premium Plastic Tableware offers the same versatility and convenience of ordinary disposable paper goods, but with more durability and the elevated look and feel of real plates, silverware, and glasses. Whether it’s the holidays, a birthday party, or simply a weeknight dinner with the family, you can serve a stress-free meal that feels more put together than paper plates and napkins, but doesn’t require an hour of washing dishes. Mozaik also offers a full assortment of plates, serving bowls, platters, and utensils, as well as appetizer and dessert sets that are perfect for tastings and special events.

BPA-free and Kosher-Parve certified, every Mozaik piece comes with the added bonus of recyclability OR reusability – when your event is over, simply recycle your used dishes and drinkware, or hand wash them and store them for your next dinner party, event, or barbecue. There’s no need to dread post-party cleanup again – you’ll spend less time in the kitchen and more time enjoying your guests (and food!).

The Mozaik Premium Plastic Stainless Steel Serving Utensil Set comes with three spoons and three forks for serving tossed salad, steamed veggies, or delicious sides. Each premium plastic server has a patented stainless steel coating with a shiny silverware-like finish that looks stylish and elegant even while scooping the heaviest mashed potatoes or pasta dishes without bending. When the event is over, recycle or hand wash the servers for future use.
